scope: Two previously recorded alternating North Country split-screen trials at 1180x820 in WSL software GLES2, with both cars controlled. Desktop only.
method: Use per-frame CSV rows whose complete swap-to-swap interval is inside the same 30-second race window. All selected swap calls were measured, the drawable epoch stayed constant, and no capture records were dropped. Outside-swap time is each frame interval minus its ending swap call.
decision: The median gain occurred outside the swap call in both desktop orders. Inspect engine and renderer work before attempting changes to the desktop swap path.
limits: Outside-swap time includes work, scheduling and waits; it is not CPU time, GPU time or energy. The two paired orders cannot establish iPad behavior. The per-frame filter differs from the complete one-second samples used for queue totals.
